description: Returns the recorded position history of one APRS station for the last 1–48 hours, oldest first: time (UTC), latitude/longitude (WGS84), altitude (m), speed (km/h) and course (degrees). Long histories are thinned evenly to at most the requested number of points, always keeping the first and the last. If nothing was recorded in the window, the most recent older points still held are returned and marked as older. Stations that ask not to be archived (APRS "!x!" marker) return no history.

callsign.description: Station callsign with optional SSID, for example TA4OHN-10. Case-insensitive.

hours.description: How far back to read the history, in hours (1–48, default 6).

max_points.description: Maximum number of track points to return (1–200, default 100).

name: get_station_track
title: Get station position history
